title: REAPS: An All-Atom Receptor-Aware Geometric Deep Learning Framework for De Novo Design of Linear and Macrocyclic Peptide Binders.
authors: Qiu, Yongkang; Qiao, Jingxin; Zhu, Lengjing; Du, Le; Yang, Shengyong; Zou, Jun
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文提出一个以受体全原子环境为上下文的几何图神经网络REAPS，用于线性和环状肽结合物的从头序列设计，并在NK3R上经实验验证，属于蛋白质结构相关的AI设计方法创新。
abstract: Peptide therapeutics occupy a critical niche between small molecules and biologics, yet the sequence design of peptide binders remains challenging because their bioactive conformations and interfacial fitness are dictated by the receptor microenvironment. Current computational approaches largely treat this as a generic inverse folding problem that relies on backbone geometry alone, overlooking the detailed physicochemical constraints of the receptor pocket. To bridge this gap, we introduce the REceptor-Aware Peptide Sequence Designer (REAPS), a geometric graph neural network that reframes sequence design for peptide binders by treating the receptor as a fully observable all-atom context. Multidimensional evaluations show that REAPS outperforms the widely used inverse folding model ProteinMPNN in sequence recovery, structural fidelity, and interface-level biophysical metrics across both linear and macrocyclic peptide binders. We further integrate REAPS with structural hallucination in a closed-loop de novo discovery pipeline, yielding peptide candidates with experimentally verified functional activity at the neurokinin-3 receptor (NK3R). The source code, model checkpoints, processed data sets, preprocessing scripts, and an example design workflow are publicly available at https://github.com/Mistletoe-git/REAPS.
abstract_zh: 肽类治疗药物在小分子药物和生物制剂之间占据着关键地位，然而肽结合物的序列设计仍具挑战性，因为其生物活性构象和界面适应性由受体微环境决定。当前计算方法大多将其视为一个通用逆折叠问题，仅依赖骨架几何结构，忽视了受体口袋的详细物理化学约束。为弥合这一差距，我们引入了受体感知肽序列设计器（REAPS），这是一种几何图神经网络，通过将受体视为完全可观测的全原子上下文，重新构建肽结合物的序列设计。多维评估表明，REAPS在序列恢复、结构保真度以及界面级生物物理指标方面，均优于广泛使用的逆折叠模型ProteinMPNN，适用于线性和大环肽结合物。我们进一步将REAPS与结构幻觉集成于闭环从头发现流程中，生成了在神经激肽-3受体（NK3R）上具有实验验证功能活性的肽候选物。源代码、模型检查点、处理后的数据集、预处理脚本及示例设计工作流可在 https://github.com/Mistletoe-git/REAPS 公开获取。
